verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser has a dedicated startups and entrepreneurs practice. It says its attorneys wrote the founder guide 'Immigration for Startups', and it frankly notes that founders often must adapt visas meant for other purposes. An O-1 practice page also exists and covers O-3 dependents. Beyond that, the evidence shows only the startup practice page and the O-1 page, not the full menu the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented coverage of H-1B (including cap-exempt routes), E-2, TN and founder green-card paths; explicit visa-selection guidance in the firm's own materials; independent corroboration.
